about: Cases where earlier reviews found bugs. Copy a fixture to a scratch folder, give the agent the prompt with that folder as its project, then check the expectations. Fixtures are sites before the skill ran.

evals.prompt: Add an agent view to my site. Use the defaults.
expectations: Endpoints from templates/astro are in src/pages and the build succeeds
Base.astro renders view.headTags(), with JSON-LD on the homepage only
robots.txt keeps the Sitemap line and gains one marked door-policy block
verify.mjs passes open with --write and closed
The footer has a visible For agents link

evals.prompt: Set up a door policy for my site.
expectations: The agent asks five questions in one message, the first being how AI should treat the site (anything / files first / no AI) with the training follow-up
Files first by default: user-fetch agents (Claude-User, ChatGPT-User…) get 'Allow: /$'; crawlers don't
The middleware is installed even without the guest book, and verify passes the markdown-on-request checks
robots.txt image Allow lines name the exact files the agent files list (e.g. Allow: /projects/tidewater/01.jpg$), never a file type like /*.jpg$; the locked secret-thing project is named nowhere

evals.prompt: I'd rather AI didn't read my pages. Can you set that up?
expectations: The request maps to files first with training set to "no" (or the agent asks, naming both choices), never files first with training unstated
Training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended…) get Disallow: / and can't read /work/*.md or any image
/.well-known/tdmrep.json and the tdm-reservation tag are present, and /agents calls them a stated reservation, not a lock
The hand-off says what files first does and doesn't do in plain words

evals.prompt: Add an agent view to my site.
expectations: The agent asks the five questions in one message with defaults (the AI question first, with its training follow-up), or lists the defaults if it can't ask
drafts/battery-dashboard.html and the work behind js/gate.js are named in no generated file, in content.mjs or in package.json
The hand-off mentions the client-side password gate and the drafts folder as publicly served, without copying their content
vercel.json redirects /door-policy, /package.json and /middleware.js; .vercelignore is present
robots.txt keeps 'Disallow: /drafts/' and the Sitemap line

evals.prompt: Quiero que los agentes de IA puedan leer mi web. Usa lo que venga por defecto.
expectations: config.mjs has lang: "es"
llms.txt and /agents never promise case studies (no 'case studies included', no /work row)
The guest book defaults to off unless the agent confirms the site is on Vercel
The person's name and the site's Spanish text are used as written

evals.prompt: I don't want AI companies scraping my portfolio or training on my work. Can you stop that?
expectations: The skill triggers and recommends 'no AI at all' (reading: "no-ai")
The agent says plainly that robots.txt is a stated wish, not a lock: training and search crawlers say they follow it, some person-triggered tools say it may not apply, nothing enforces it

robots.txt has every AI_CRAWLERS name and the ai.robots.txt snapshot (credited, dated) under Disallow: /, the __usage_ai-training group and the Content Signals text with its Article 4 reservation; Applebot is not blocked
No page links to /llms.txt in its head; the bingbot ai-training and ai-grounding tags and the tdm-reservation tag are present; /.well-known/tdmrep.json exists
Only /llms.txt is published (no /llms-full.txt, /profile.json or /work/*.md), with who the person is and how to get in touch; /agents is titled 'About AI on this site'
The guest book defaults to off, offered as a counter of the AI tools that came anyway

evals.prompt: Add an agent view to my React site.
expectations: The For agents link is in index.html's static markup, outside #root
The catch-all rewrite is narrowed so /work/nope.md is a 404
verify.mjs passes against local-server.mjs with --static dist (no false failures from the catch-all)

evals.prompt: Add an agent view to my site, files first please.
expectations: The agent asks whether to keep the existing complete GPTBot block (default: keep)
After the build, GPTBot is still kept out of everything (no Allow lines name it)
The person's comment and groups outside the door-policy markers are unchanged
verify.mjs passes, noting GPTBot is stricter than files first

evals.prompt: Can you improve my site's SEO? Titles, meta descriptions, that kind of thing.
expectations: door-policy is not used
